reason: The single documented archive request returned HTTP 200 and 29 bytes but no retained WMO, PIL, KLGA runtime, DT, or HR metadata lines. No matching bulletin or historical issuance/receipt field was established. HTTP success and generic near-real-time archive documentation do not prove historical availability.
limitations: Response body was not persisted or displayed; exact diagnostic text is unknown. Therefore do not assert that the archive categorically lacks the bulletin.
The query bounds are documented UTC database-search bounds, not an independently defined issuance/receipt timestamp.
No alternative windows, endpoints, dates, cycles, models or stations queried after the negative result.
Previously verified MOS JSON row identity/runtime is inherited from SOURCE-DISCOVERY.json, not fetched again. Its original response hash was not recorded and is not reconstructed here.
Hashes attest to responses obtained now, not historical publication.
competition_effect: Methodological negative finding only. dot-001 remains draft; sample coverage remains at most 3 events, not 30. Historical rules/fees and execution/open-close gaps remain.
